thread:
alex: Quick sync — proposal to ship a bundled marketplace entry: LangChain adapter + LlamaIndex connector + hw-quant profile from Marco's team. Goals: unified onboarding, one-click demo, and joint announce.

sarah: love it. do we have a cutoff for the tech smoke tests? want to avoid last-minute perf surprises. :eyes:

jia: i can run the compatibility matrix across seq-len profiles and quantized weights. plan: run three workloads (chat, embed, rerank) and capture p50/p95. will post artifacts.

marco: sending the quant profiles today. note: t4 vs a100 perf differs for int8 path, recommend we list supported hw SKU in listing. also need to validate our on-prem package.

clare: marketing ask — need a 1-paragraph blurb + 3 screenshots for the marketplace tile. emi, you ok to draft?

emi: yep, i’ll draft. prefer we target a soft announce w/partners first week of next month. any blackout windows?

alex: ops: can someone provision a demo sandbox with SSO + sample dataset? ideally links for partners to self-start. @deploy-bot any chance for a ephemeral env?

deploy-bot: created sandbox cluster: demo-17411122 (expires in 7 days). kube context: demo-17411122. Run `kubectl -n demo get pods` to check.

jia: thanks. i'll run the smoke harness. sample command: ```./smoke_test.sh --model redwood-llama-quant --profiles seq128,seq512 --reps 50```

marco: for SSO we need OIDC config + service account mapping. sending endpoints and cert thumbprint in DM.

clare: legal note — we need partner logos licensing signoff and a short co-marketing agreement. @legal-bot any templates we can reuse?

legal-bot: uploaded a partner co-marketing template to /legal/partner-co-marketing-v2.docx. recommend 48h review. include approved logo usage and announcement cadence.

alex: action items summary: 1) Jia: run matrix and attach perf tables (due in 48h). 2) Marco: provide quant profile + OIDC info (today). 3) Emi/Clare: draft marketplace blurb + screenshots (3 days). 4) Legal: review asset use (48h). 5) Ops: keep demo sandbox up until announce, add sample creds. I'll own the release checklist.

sarah: i'll add a row in the partner tracker and flag for marketing lead.

jia: starting tests now, will ping when done. linking raw logs here once finished.

marco: quick heads-up — HW partner wants a brief internal tech review before public announce. can we do a 30m demo on Thurs?

emi: Thurs 10am PT works for me. count marketing and product.

alex: ok locked. Thursday 10am PT demo. thanks all — let's keep updates here. :thumbsup:
